info.name: Hospigo 2.1f: template library, terminology, branch modules, starter, access log, dashboard
info.description: Step 2.1f. Needs the Hospigo Local environment (baseUrl, staffPassword, superadminPassword, branchAdminPassword, indigoPassword) and the demo seed with the Indigo demo people (SEED_INDIGO_PASSWORD). Cleans up after itself (designs removed, assignment taken away, words cleared).

item.name: 0 Setup
Login SuperAdmin (north main)
Login Branch Admin (north main)
Login Receptionist (north main)
Login Indigo Owner
Login Indigo Employee
The Owner finds north and south

exec: const north = items.find(h => h.code === 'DEMO_NORTH'); const south = items.find(h => h.code === 'DEMO_SOUTH');
pm.test('both demo hospitals are listed', () => { pm.expect(north).to.exist; pm.expect(south).to.exist; });

item.name: 1 Library (Indigo Owner)
Only the Owner: an Employee gets 403
A hospital token gets 401
The Owner adds the designed samples
Pressing it again adds nothing
The library holds two to three templates per document

exec: for (const d of ['REGISTRATION_SLIP','RECEIPT','PRESCRIPTION','PATIENT_REPORT','PATIENT_CARD']) { const n = t.filter(x => x.docType === d && !x.retired && x.key !== undefined && !x.key.startsWith('custom-')).length; pm.test(d + ' has 2 to 3 samples', () => pm.expect(n).to.be.within(2, 3)); }
const bill = t.find(x => x.key === 'bill-classic'); const bill2 = t.find(x => x.key === 'bill-modern');

item.name: A copy under a new name
A bad request is refused
The copy is taken out again
The Owner assigns two bills to north
An unknown template is refused
2 The hospital chooses
The SuperAdmin sees exactly the two assigned bills
The receptionist may not (403)
The SuperAdmin chooses the modern bill for the whole hospital
It is marked in use
A Branch Admin cannot choose for the whole hospital (403)
A Branch Admin chooses for the own branch
A template that was not assigned is not found (404)
3 Terminology
The Owner sets a word
The hospital reads it
Markup is refused
An Employee assigned to north clears it
An Employee cannot touch south (403)
The hospital word is gone again
4 Branch modules, starter, access log, dashboard
The Owner sets the main branch modules to what it already has
OPD cannot be switched off for one branch
An Employee cannot switch branch modules (403)
The Owner runs the starter masters (safe to press twice)
An Employee cannot run it (403)
The SuperAdmin reads the Indigo access log of the own hospital
The receptionist cannot (403)
The dashboard summary: SuperAdmin sees money and approvals
The dashboard summary: the receptionist has no approvals block
5 Clean up
The Owner enters north (to clean up the chosen designs)
The branch design is removed
The hospital design is removed
The assignment is taken away again
